meta.name: bluebubbles
meta.description: Use when you need to send or manage iMessages via BlueBubbles (recommended iMessage integration). Calls go through the generic message tool with channel="bluebubbles".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 BlueBubbles 发送和管理 iMessage
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从电脑发送 iMessage 并管理对话。
copy.tagline_en: Send and manage iMessages via BlueBubbles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send iMessage from your computer and manage conversations.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 BlueBubbles 发送和管理 iMessage：发送文字、附件、表情反应（tapback）、编辑/撤回消息、回复特定消息，以及管理群聊。
howto.when: 当你需要发送或管理 iMessage 时触发，例如要求“给我妈发条短信”或“给张三发个文件”。

say.text: 给我妈发条短信，说晚上不回家吃饭。
say.note: Claude 会询问收件人信息并发送 iMessage。

say.text: 给张三发个文件，路径是 /tmp/report.pdf。
对李四上一条消息点个赞。
say.note: Claude 会添加一个爱心反应。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and manage iMessages via BlueBubbles: send text, attachments, tapbacks, edit/unsend messages, reply in threads, and manage group chats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to send or manage iMessages, e.g., 'text my mom' or 'send a file to John'.

say_en.text: Text my mom that I won't be home for dinner.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for recipient details and send an iMessage.

say_en.text: Send a file to John, path is /tmp/report.pdf.
Like the last message from Jane.
say_en.note: Claude will add a heart reaction.
